name: Yellowstone National Park
description: Widely held to be the first national park in the world, known for its wildlife and geothermal features.

name: Yosemite National Park
description: Internationally recognized for its granite cliffs, waterfalls, clear streams, giant sequoia groves, and biological diversity.

name: Zion National Park
description: Known for Zion Canyon, a deep and narrow canyon with stunning reddish and tan-colored Navajo Sandstone.

name: Grand Canyon National Park
description: Encompasses the Grand Canyon, a massive gorge of the Colorado River, widely considered one of the Wonders of the World.

name: Glacier National Park
description: Features parts of two mountain ranges, over 130 named lakes, and hundreds of species of animals and plants.

name: Acadia National Park
description: Protects the natural beauty of the highest rocky headlands along the Atlantic coastline of the United States.

name: Rocky Mountain National Park
description: Features majestic mountain views, mountain lakes, a variety of wildlife, and varied climates and environments.

name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
description: The most visited national park in the United States, renowned for its diversity of plant and animal life.

name: Olympic National Park
description: Known for the diversity of its ecosystems, ranging from the rugged Pacific coastline to temperate rainforests.

name: Denali National Park
description: Centered on Denali, the highest mountain in North America, featuring a mix of forest, tundra, and glaciers.

name: Joshua Tree National Park
description: Characterized by rugged rock formations and stark desert landscapes, named for the region's twisted, bristled Joshua trees.

name: Arches National Park
description: Contains the highest density of natural arches in the world, featuring more than 2,000 natural sandstone arches.

name: Bryce Canyon National Park
description: Despite its name, it is not a canyon but a collection of giant natural amphitheaters along the eastern side of the Paunsaugunt Plateau.

name: Grand Teton National Park
description: Encompasses the major peaks of the 40-mile-long Teton Range as well as most of the northern sections of Jackson Hole.

name: Sequoia National Park
description: Famous for its giant sequoia trees, including the General Sherman tree, the largest tree on Earth by volume.
